description:
Port the SSE parser from pi-ai (see anthropic.ts:300-348). Accept binary chunks, buffer incomplete lines, emit `%SSE.Event{event, data, id}` structs when a complete event is received. Handle both `\r\n` and `\n` terminators.

Pure functional module: `SSE.decode/1` returns `{events, remainder}`. Unit tests.
title: Incremental SSE decoder
